topic.title: Inbox
topic.shortdesc: Only what needs you, whichever business it is from: actions to approve, things you asked for that didn't finish, and messages worth reading.

image.alt: The Inbox on a phone: an action to approve with the product it changes, a request that didn't finish, and two messages from the assistant.

body.p: The Inbox is short on purpose. Everything that was done, by you asking or by itself, is in Activity; routine automated work is summed up in the daily digest. When nothing needs you the Inbox says so. The number on the Inbox tab is how many things are in it.

Things that never make a card here: a small thing you asked for that was simply done (a reminder set, an item added to a list: it being on the list is the confirmation), a task's progress updates, orders, social activity and digests, and mail that was only sorted.

Each action waiting for your yes, in full, with the record it would change (the product, order or customer, read live). Approve or Reject it here; Edit and Ask for changes work as on the Approvals page. The first five are shown, with a link to the rest.

Something you asked for in Chat in the last two days that failed, with the reason. Retry runs it again and opens it, Open shows the conversation (reply there to change what you asked), and Dismiss clears it from this device's Inbox. Work that came in by itself and failed is listed in the daily digest and in Activity, not here.

Unread messages that matter: an answer to something you asked that arrived while the app was not on screen, a message your assistant chose to send you, reminders, alerts, quotes and supplier replies, and briefings. The first button opens what it is about (and marks it read); Dismiss marks it read without opening it, and Dismiss all clears the group. They all stay in Notifications.
